calendar.text: Ve todos los coches y reservas en una sola línea de tiempo. Días libres, solapes y la semana siguiente, sin hojas de cálculo.

move.title: Mueve reservas en un par de clics
move.text: ¿Hay que cambiar fechas o coche? Arrastra la reserva en el calendario — el horario se actualiza al momento.

platform.title: Todo el flujo en un solo lugar
platform.text: Pedidos, zonas de entrega, transfers, vouchers y contactos de la empresa viven en el mismo admin — menos caos, más control de la flota.

customerEmail.title: Thank you for your reservation – rovaro
customerEmail.weReceived: We have received your reservation request and truly appreciate your trust in our service. Our team is currently reviewing the details and will contact you shortly to confirm the booking and ensure everything is arranged to your expectations.
customerEmail.availabilityDisclaimer: This email does not guarantee that the vehicle is available on these dates at the stated price. Our manager will send you the official confirmation after contacting you and rechecking availability.
customerEmail.excludeCityDeliveryNote: Not including delivery to the city.
customerEmail.paymentLinkNotConfigured: El enlace de pago aún no está configurado. Lo enviaremos en cuanto el pago en línea esté disponible.
customerEmail.totalIncludesInsuranceNote: El total incluye el seguro y los extras seleccionados.
customerEmail.officialIntro: Your booking is confirmed. The supplier confirmed the vehicle, and your Booking Fee payment has been received.
customerEmail.officialPdfNote: The official confirmation PDF is attached to this email. Please keep it for vehicle pick-up.
customerEmail.step1: 1. Our team carefully reviews your reservation details.
customerEmail.step2: 2. We contact you to confirm availability and clarify any additional preferences.
customerEmail.step3: 3. Once confirmed, you will receive a final confirmation with all necessary information.
customerEmail.questionsParagraph: If you have any questions in the meantime, please feel free to reply to this email — we will be happy to assist you personally.
